page: UpCloud GPU-128xCPU-640GB-8xRTXPRO6000 is an x86_64 architecture GPU-accelerated server instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 shared vCPUs and 640.0 GB of system memory, providing a ratio of 5.0 GB of RAM per core. The instance includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The primary hardware highlight is the integration of eight NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs. This configuration does not include local storage, meaning storage resources must be attached externally. The shared CPU allocation model represents a resource-density tradeoff, balancing massive parallel GPU compute capacity with shared host CPU cycles.

Given the hardware profile, this server is designed for workloads requiring massive parallel processing capabilities, such as deep learning, large-scale AI model training, and complex data science jobs. The high GPU count and substantial memory capacity support memory-intensive parallel computations, though the shared CPU allocation should be considered for workloads requiring sustained single-core CPU performance.
